summary: The AES byte writer omitted input length, allowing null padding to produce collisions, exercised by the existing padding test with BAD_KEY. The fix adds a final AES round mixing the original length into both 64-bit halves. Reverse only that operation in src/aes_hash.rs, which the selected test directly exercises. Both source regions occur exactly once. The test helper was updated by this fix; execution requires an AES-capable x86/x86_64 target with target-feature=+aes. No tests were run.
